title: Semantic digest definition — v1 (frozen)
description: Defines the 'semantic digest' used 12 times as normative in the source pack but never defined there (10_DUAL_VALIDATION_ADDENDUM §B1). Distinct from packageContentDigest (floop-container-format.v1.json), which covers the whole archive. semanticDigest covers ONLY definition.json, minus presentation-only fields, and is what the P0 gate 'layout-only edits MUST NOT alter semantic digest' (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §3/§14) is checked against.
algorithm: 2. EXCLUDE: walk the parsed structure and remove, at every depth, any object member whose key exactly matches an entry in exclusionListV1 below, along with its entire subtree. There is no per-field override in v1 (a future semanticDigestVersion may add an explicit 'semantic: true' escape hatch; v1 does not have one — see limitations).

3. CANONICALIZE the remaining structure per the fb-loop-canon-1 profile (see canonicalization.v1.json): sort object keys by UTF-16 code unit; NFC-normalize every string; forbid IEEE-754 doubles (integers and constrained decimal strings only — a definition.json containing a bare JSON float at this stage is a LOOP-PKG-003 canonicalization error, not silently coerced); no insignificant whitespace; UTF-8 encode.
4. DIGEST: SHA-256 the canonical UTF-8 bytes. Format as 'sha256:<lowercase-hex>'.

5. The result is semanticDigest. It is reported alongside semanticDigestVersion (this document's registryId) in every validation report, build receipt, and installation record, so a verifier without this document can still tell which exclusion list + canonicalization profile produced a given digest.
exclusionSemantics: A key is matched by exact name at ANY depth in the definition.json tree (node objects, edge objects, gateway objects, the definition root). Matching is structural, not path-scoped: a node's 'presentation' object and the definition root's 'presentation' object are both dropped by the same rule. This is deliberately coarse for v1 — see limitations.
limitationsV1: No per-field override: if a future authoring surface needs a field literally named 'notes' to be semantic (e.g. a verifier's required note-taking output, as opposed to authoring UI notes), it must be renamed to avoid collision with this exclusion list, or a v2 registry must add an explicit override mechanism. Renaming is the v1-safe path.

Exclusion is unconditional and un-namespaced: a 'layout' key on a NON-presentation object (if one is ever introduced) would still be silently dropped. Spec authors adding new fields to LoopDefinition MUST avoid these five key names for anything semantic.
This registry does not define presentation-vs-semantic for definition.bpmn — that file is excluded entirely at the container level (floop-container-format.v1.json), not filtered at the key level.
conformanceRule: LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1 §12: a loop-engine release is non-conformant if it produces a different semanticDigest for a package that differs only in excluded fields, or a different digest across two runs of the same canonicalization over byte-identical input (determinism — golden vectors in fixtures/canonicalization/ prove this over 1,000 repeated runs per 07_TEST_CONFORMANCE_PLAN §4b).
